prompt: Create a website that includes information on Australian Shepherds.
summary: A static informational website about Australian Shepherds covering breed history, temperament, appearance, coat colors, exercise and grooming needs, health, and training tips. Since this is read-only editorial content with no user accounts, transactions, or data that changes after deployment, a single static_site is the smallest sufficient primitive — all content and any filtering (e.g., by coat color) can be handled client-side in the browser.

services.name: aussie-shepherd-guide
services.buildCommand: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp *.html styles.css script.js dist/ && cp -r assets dist/assets
